## Big idea

`@Transactional` on a service method: all DB work commits together or rolls back together.

```text
start transaction
  update A
  update B  (fails) → rollback A and B
end
```

## Practice

1. Two updates in one `@Transactional` method; throw after first; confirm rollback.
2. Call from controller → service (proxy applies).

## Reasoning

Self-invocation can skip transaction proxy — same lesson as AOP.
